name: codex-subagent
description: Persistent BYOK worker agents for Codex, using VS Code language models through MCP.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Delegate work to your VS Code models.
[Set up workers](command:codexSubagent.setup)
[New worker](command:codexSubagent.newWorker)
[Diagnostics](command:codexSubagent.diagnostics)
[Retry host](command:codexSubagent.retryHost)

No worker models are enabled.
[Enable Model](command:codexSubagent.enableModel)
[Open User Settings](command:codexSubagent.openModelSettings)

allowWrite.description: Per-model write policy: omitted or true allows workspace-write workers for this model; false restricts all workspace edits and change tools.

allowShell.description: Per-model shell policy: omitted or true may offer shell to this model's workspace-write workers; false restricts it. Shell still requires workspace-write and user approval.

numSessions.description: Maximum simultaneously active conversations for this model in the owning workspace store. Built-in default when omitted: 1.

maxToolRounds.description: Per-model tool rounds per turn before manual resumption is required. Built-in default when omitted: 40.

turnTimeoutSeconds.description: Per-model deadline per turn, including tool execution. Built-in default when omitted: 600.

autoCompact.description: Per-model automatic summarization before limits. Built-in default when omitted: true.

modelOptions.description: Provider-specific request options passed to VS Code sendRequest for this exact model, such as supported reasoning options. Arbitrary provider JSON is allowed; never put credentials here. Omitted means no extra options.

codexSubagent.models.description: The sole enabled-model source: each key is an exact VS Code model ID that is enabled for workers, and the value is that model's policy. Entry order is the automatic-selection priority. Enabling a model through 'Codex Subagent: Enable Model' adds its exact ID here (User settings only); disabling removes it. Manual User Settings edits take effect immediately. Workspace settings never enable or expand models. An explicit subagent_spawn model must match a key exactly (no name/vendor aliases). An empty object means no models are enabled: workers, tools and inference are unavailable until at least one model is enabled. This pool is the sole enabled-model and per-model permission/tuning source; the opt-in resources settings add explicit aggregate budgets across roots and hosts; omitted numSessions/maxToolRounds/turnTimeoutSeconds/autoCompact use built-in defaults 1/40/600/true.

codexSubagent.resources.enabled.description: Opt in to governed isolated create-bind-start. Aggregate limits cover governed workers across all roots, worktrees, stores and extension hosts for this OS user. Legacy spawn and runner per-root reopen settings retain their scope.

codexSubagent.resources.modelCapacity.description: Aggregate simultaneous governed inference requests across all models. numSessions continues limiting each exact model within its owning root/session store. One slot is reserved for explicit validation/integration work.

codexSubagent.resources.runnableCapacity.description: Aggregate governed inference or non-runner tool effects. Dependency, message, runner and approval waits hold no runnable slot.

codexSubagent.resources.runnerCapacity.description: Aggregate physical runner reservations for governed workers, including setup, approval, import, cleanup and quarantine. Applies live to new grants; existing leases drain.

codexSubagent.resources.storageBytes.description: Aggregate conservative retained-store accounting plus in-flight storage reservations. Metadata is included. A materialized governed runner reserves 1 GiB. User OS shell writes are not a disk quota.

codexSubagent.resources.serviceReserve.description: One aggregate model, runnable and runner slot is reserved for coordinator-designated validation/integration work.

codexSubagent.taskBoard.enabled.description: Opt in to the persistent task board. When false, the host refuses every board MCP call with feature_disabled, workers receive no private board tools, and the Task Board view stays hidden; the tools still appear in MCP discovery. The board stores team, task, dependency, candidate and validation records in this workspace folder: it never dispatches workers, edits files or accepts work on its own. Machine scope, so a checkout cannot enable it.

codexSubagent.isolatedViews.enabled.description: Opt in to shared immutable snapshots and private file overlays for explicitly bound team workers. Requires taskBoard.enabled in User Settings. Bind a stopped owned team member before resuming it; initial unbound turns retain legacy behavior. Shell execution for these workers needs the separate isolatedViews.runners.enabled opt-in; without it, bound run_command fails with isolated_shell_unavailable and never falls back to legacy shell. Disabling this setting preserves private content and permanently marked sessions fail closed. No automatic dispatch or integration.

codexSubagent.isolatedViews.runners.enab.description: Opt in to physical shell execution for explicitly bound isolated workers. Requires taskBoard.enabled and isolatedViews.enabled in User Settings. When false (the default) no new runner execution storage is created, bound run_command keeps failing with isolated_shell_unavailable and nothing falls back to legacy shell or approval; runner results and reconciliation already recorded for this root stay readable and cleanable. When true, a workspace-write worker whose model still allows writes and shell may run a command in a private materialized copy of its exact revision after the normal command approval; changed files are imported into the private overlay only, and the main workspace is untouched. Never a sandbox: the command has this host's real OS access. Machine scope, so a checkout cannot enable it.

codexSubagent.isolatedViews.runners.capa.description: Slot count for this canonical workspace root's runner pool (1-8), one pool shared by every window that owns that root's store. A slot is held from materializing the private copy through approval, execution, import and cleanup, so quarantined leases also consume slots. Applies when the pool is opened or the host restarts; a live edit does not rebuild running slots. Machine scope, so a checkout cannot raise it.

codexSubagent.isolatedViews.runners.maxQ.description: Maximum isolated runner requests that may wait for a slot (0-256). Requests queue before the approval prompt, so the queue bounds requested work rather than already-approved commands. Applies when the pool is opened or the host restarts. Machine scope, so a checkout cannot raise it.

codexSubagent.notifyOnCompletion.description: Notify when an observed worker finishes or fails.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test "tests/*.test.cjs"
scripts.test:host: npm run build && npm run build:test && node tests/run-host-tests.cjs

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Diagnostics and model setup are available; worker execution requires a trusted filesystem workspace.
